sets.title: Sets and stickers
sets.help: Members collect stickers set by set. A hidden set is in no pack and no album, so you can build it first. Upload PNG, WebP or JPEG art (PNG or WebP with a transparent background looks best); each image is resized and stored as WebP.
sets.empty: There are no sets yet. Start with the four starter sets (32 original stickers) or make your own.
sets.starter_added: {count, plural, =0 {The starter sets are already here.} one {Added # starter set, hidden. Show it when you're ready.} other {Added # starter sets, hidden. Show them when you're ready.}}
sets.name: Name
sets.badges_help: With FoF Badges you can award a badge to members who complete a set.
sets.delete_set_confirm: Delete the set "{name}" and all its stickers? Members lose them from their albums. This can't be undone.
sets.delete_sticker_confirm: Delete "{name}"? {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has it yet.} one {# member loses it from their album.} other {# members lose it from their albums.}} This can't be undone.
sets.gift_help: Give a member extra packs, for a contest prize or an event. They are not counted against the daily limit.
sets.gift_sent: {count, plural, one {Gave # pack to {username}.} other {Gave # packs to {username}.}}

settings.nav: Show Sticker Book in the sidebar
settings.reactions: Let members put stickers on posts
settings.reactions_help: Each member can put one sticker from their own album on a post.
settings.odds_help: How often each rarity comes out of a pack, in percent. They don't need to add up to 100; they're used as weights.
settings.pity_help: A member's pack is certain to have a legendary when it is this many packs in a row without one (40 means the 40th pack). 0 turns it off.
settings.guarantee_rare: At least one rare in every pack
settings.guarantee_rare_help: The last sticker in a pack is rare or better when the rest are all common.
settings.first_post: An extra pack for a member's first post of the day
settings.likes_per_pack: Likes received for an extra pack
settings.likes_per_pack_help: Needs Likes. Each member's like on a post counts once, even if they unlike it and like it again. 0 turns it off.
settings.trade_min_age_help: New accounts can't offer or accept trades until they are this old, so a batch of new accounts can't pass their stickers to one member. 0 turns it off.
settings.extra_cap_help: The most packs a member can earn in a day from posting and likes, on top of the free daily pack.
